start.intro: Hi! I'm Juan, a Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer with experience building software for a multinational company. I specialize in web development with Nuxt and Vue, and mobile applications with React Native and Expo. I also build APIs using Express.js and MongoDB, while integrating AI solutions to create scalable software and streamline processes.

unabase.title: VxPro unabase
unabase.description: A new version of the ERP business management platform that centralizes sales, purchases, expenses, accounting, and financial reporting in a single dashboard, helping businesses make real-time, data-driven decisions.

bullets: Building a new version of a creative-industry ERP with Nuxt 3, modern interfaces and a scalable architecture.
Backend with Express.js and MongoDB: REST APIs, Google OAuth authentication and business logic.
AI integration (Claude Code, OpenAI API) to automate file analysis and code generation.
CI/CD and Git under Feature/Hotfix strategies, with Scrum, Notion and GitHub for team collaboration.
